messages:
devon: Heads-up: Riverbend private VPC deploy window Tue Mar 31 02:00-05:00 UTC. Rolling control-plane + agent v2.1.0. Primary goals: no config drift, keep p50/p95 latency within SLO, and smooth KV cache warmup. Need explicit owners for: smoke, DB migration, rollback, and VPN verification. Plan below — please ack who you own.

1) 01:30 UTC - final checklist and freeze.
2) 02:00 UTC - start rolling deploy (canary first).
3) 02:20 UTC - canary evaluation, run full smoke.
4) 02:40-03:30 UTC - ramp remaining nodes if canary good.
5) fallback -> tag v2.0.4, drain new DaemonSet, rollback manifests.

mariam: I'll own smoke and e2e verification (auth, embeddings, routing). Will run the smoke script and post results here.

ranjit: I'll own DB migration. Will pre-snapshot, run migration in canary, and have down-script ready. Migration size ~2.3GB; pre-warm plan in place.

emily: I'll validate RBAC, KMS key rotation, and secret mounts pre/post deploy. Will run the verify-secrets job before 01:45 UTC.

tiago: I'll be on-call for rollback/infracode. On-call window 01:45-06:00 UTC. If rollback happens, I'll coordinate kube revert + node drains.

ops-bot: CI: deploy/riverbend queued by devon. Job link: https://ci.redwood.test/riverbend/deploy/1718900000 (ETA 02:05 UTC). Logs will stream to the thread.

devon: Quick question — are we doing a 10% canary for 20m? @mariam can you validate traffic shape during canary and confirm artifact behavior?

mariam: 10% for 20m works for e2e. I'll focus on auth handshakes and embeddings latency keys.

ranjit: Migration plan: snapshot at 01:50 UTC, apply migration in canary at 02:10, verify index convergence, then apply remaining. Rollback plan: restore snapshot + run migrate down. I'll post the exact commands before 01:40.

emily: Secrets/KMS check: key rotation window clear, IAM roles scoped. Running `./verify-secrets --env riverbend` at 01:00 UTC.

tiago: Pager on. I'll tail agent logs + observability dashboards. Will escalate to SRE if error rate > 1% or token errors spike.

devon: If rollback triggered, use image tag v2.0.4 and remove v2.1.0 DaemonSet, then restart controllers. Keep me looped.

mariam: Smoke run (canary): PASS — auth ok, embeddings ok, route table stable. Snippet: ```
[2026-03-31T02:24:10Z] smoke: auth OK (200)
[2026-03-31T02:24:15Z] smoke: embeddings latency 42ms p50
[2026-03-31T02:24:20Z] smoke: request routing OK
```

tiago: :thumbsup: watching logs. No trace anomalies in the canary window so far.

ranjit: Customer coord: reached out to Riverbend SRE (alice@riverbend) to confirm DB maintenance window and replication lag thresholds.

devon: Final checklist at 01:30 UTC. If nobody raises blockers by 01:35 we'll proceed with the plan. Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. :rocket:
